name: Wren the Tinkerer
conversations: Careful, that anvil's warm. Everything in here is warm. Or sharp. Or both. Welcome!
I'm building a telescope to get a proper look at the Great Tree. Third try. The first two turned out to be excellent kaleidoscopes.
Barkton sends me their broken gears, and I send them back fixed, with a little note about how they broke them.
They never read the notes. I can tell, because the same gear comes back every month looking guilty.
Ever notice the Great Tree glows a bit dimmer every year? I measured it. With a candle and a very patient squint.
The numbers say it's fading. My gut says it's just tired. My gut's been right more often, honestly.
This hammer belonged to my mother. The handle's new. And the head. But the spirit's the same.
That's an old Rootholm joke. They tell it about everything. Their bridges, their boats, their grandparents.
